sehemu: Part III: The Prime Minister, the Cabinet and the Government
jina: Prime Minister of the United Republic
maudhui: (1) There shall be a Prime Minister of the United Republic who shall be appointed by the President in accordance with the provisions of this Article and who, before assuming office, shall take and subscribe before the President the oath relating to the office of Prime Minister. (2) As soon as possible, and in any event within fourteen days after assuming office, the President shall appoint a Member of Parliament elected from a constituency from the political party having a majority of Members in the National Assembly to be Prime Minister, and he shall not assume office until his appointment has first been confirmed by the National Assembly by a resolution supported by a majority of Members of Parliament. (3) Without prejudice to the other provisions of this Constitution, the Prime Minister shall hold office until - (a) the day on which the President-elect takes the oath of office; (b) the day on which he dies while in office; (c) the day on which he resigns; (d) the day on which the President appoints another Member of Parliament to be Prime Minister; or (e) he otherwise ceases to hold the office of Prime Minister.
vifungu: (1) There shall be a Prime Minister of the United Republic who shall be appointed by the President in accordance with the provisions of this Article and who, before assuming office, shall take and subscribe before the President the oath relating to the office of Prime Minister.

(2) As soon as possible, and in any event within fourteen days after assuming office, the President shall appoint a Member of Parliament elected from a constituency from the political party having a majority of Members in the National Assembly to be Prime Minister, and he shall not assume office until his appointment has first been confirmed by the National Assembly by a resolution supported by a majority of Members of Parliament.

(3) Without prejudice to the other provisions of this Constitution, the Prime Minister shall hold office until - (a) the day on which the President-elect takes the oath of office; (b) the day on which he dies while in office; (c) the day on which he resigns; (d) the day on which the President appoints another Member of Parliament to be Prime Minister; or (e) he otherwise ceases to hold the office of Prime Minister.
